messages:
marta: FYI: we're rolling out the pinning/deprecation timeline for SDK examples. Short: docs update first, then SDK minor flip, then linter enforcement. See dates.

joe: dates?

marta: 2026-04-10 docs publish (migration guide + quick snippets); 2026-04-17 SDK minor release sets templates to include recommended_pin; 2026-05-15 soft telemetry warnings; 2026-06-01 docs CI fails on missing pin.

ling: will there be suggested pins for hosted customers?

docs-bot: yes — docs will include a "recommended_pin" value per example and a short rationale sentence. We'll also provide a CLI helper `rw pin-suggest --window 72h`.

eng-sdk: SDK will add a non-breaking notice when it detects implicit selection via env vars for 30 days prior to template flips. No runtime behavioral change during soft window.

ops-bot: Ops note: we'll emit an internal metric for unpinned examples per org so platform teams can track.

joe: can support get a templated KB and email for customers?
marta: @joe and @docs-bot will collaborate — KB draft by 2026-04-08.

ling: any changes to allowed runtime_weight values?
marta: no changes; docs will show mappings and cost/latency guidance.

eng-sdk: PR incoming for helper and a small test fixture to ensure examples are runnable.

marta: action owners listed in the migration doc. Q&A drop-in Wed 2026-04-09 09:00 PT. Ping if you need invites.
